cumulus.name: Cumulus / Spectrum-X
cumulus.title: Cumulus and Spectrum-X switching lab
cumulus.description: Practice eight-rail RoCE fabric setup, staged NVUE-style changes, BGP path faults, MTU, ECN, PFC and monitoring in a hosted educational lab.
cumulus.hardware: Spectrum Ethernet architecture; Cumulus Linux 5.14-inspired finite command subset. No Spectrum ASIC or end-to-end Spectrum-X software is executed.

quantum.name: Quantum InfiniBand
quantum.title: Quantum InfiniBand fabric lab
quantum.description: Investigate eight-rail InfiniBand fabrics, subnet-manager failover, full and limited P_Key membership, shared planes, link faults and synthetic counters.
quantum.hardware: Quantum-2/Quantum-X800 architecture references. Modeled SM administration and finite diagnostic summaries; no MLNX-OS, OpenSM, UFM or SHARP binary runs.

juniper.name: Juniper QFX
juniper.title: Juniper QFX AI fabric lab
juniper.description: Practice QFX-inspired AI fabric troubleshooting with candidate configuration, Junos-style commit and rollback, BGP, MTU and RoCE monitoring.
juniper.hardware: QFX5240 reference architecture, with a finite Junos OS Evolved-inspired command subset. No vJunos VM or QFX ASIC is executed.

arista.name: Arista EOS
arista.title: Arista EOS AI fabric lab
arista.description: Practice EOS-inspired AI fabric operations, running versus startup configuration, eight-rail paths, MTU faults and synthetic RoCE congestion monitoring.
arista.hardware: 7060X6 leaf / 7800R4 spine reference architecture. Finite EOS-inspired commands; no cEOS/vEOS image or switch ASIC is executed.
